title.zh: Coinbase Swings to $719 Million Q3 Profit on Crypto Gains
title.en: Coinbase Swings to $719 Million Q3 Profit on Crypto Gains

current_state.zh: Coinbase reported $719 million in Q3 net income ($2.51 per share) versus an expected loss, though roughly $715 million stemmed from gains on its crypto holdings, with adjusted net income at $78 million on $1.22 billion in revenue that was flat sequentially but down 35% year-over-year.
